[[File:Games.jpg|thumb|The Drainsweeper Event]]
'''Drainsweeper''' was an event in the [[Roon Colonial Games]] hosted on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. It was a three a three-stage relay race that was performed while riding on [[rockhopper]]s. Shoving was permitted in this event and racers were eliminated if they fell off their rockhopper. Some participants would fall into the racing course's central drain, where a game authority would catch them by operating a [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]-manipulating device.

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Auren Yomm Baobab]] and [[Umboo Racing Team|her team]], the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Gee Long]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[BIX]], specialized in the event and were slated to compete against the team of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]] during the Roon Games of [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]. However, when Long and Bix were unable to compete after Koong's [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[Bun-Dingo]] attempted to sabotage their team, [[Mungo Baobab]] and his [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], competed in their place and won the championship with Yomm.
